difficulty_reason: Bondal-Van den Bergh generator theorem for algebraic spaces: affine case O_X is a perfect generator (via the schemes comparison); induction step builds the generator Q ⊕ K' - Q from the direct-summand restriction lift, K the Koszul complex on f_1..f_r cutting out the reduced inverse image Z of the complement, K' = Rf_*K perfect supported on Z; vanishing of Hom(K'[n], E) = Hom(K[n], E|_V) plus the schemes orthogonal-Koszul lemma forces E|_V = R(U×X V -> V)_*E|_{U×X V} hence E = R(U -> X)_*E|_U (small detail omitted, noted), and the Q-Hom direct summand argument with the generator P on U finishes.
